Description: ComponentType includes elbow and specialty, but PKG-02 schemas/model.schema.yaml Component.component_type does not include those canonical values. Component records using those values cannot round trip through the canonical model without a vocabulary amendment or mapping.
ProposedDisposition: Reconcile with DEL-02-01 by adding a governed canonical vocabulary change or mapping elbow/specialty to accepted canonical values before relying on these component records. Stage 2 technical evidence: accepted PKG-02 schemas/model.schema.yaml now includes elbow and specialty, and tests/test_component_section_schema.py asserts PKG-03 ComponentType is a subset of the canonical model component_type enum.

Description: SectionDimension includes area_moment, volume_per_length, and mass_per_length, none of which appear in PKG-02 units.schema.yaml DimensionId or schemas/model.schema.yaml Quantity.dimension. Section property records cannot be dimensionally checked by the current PKG-02 unit contract as written.
ProposedDisposition: Align section property dimensions with DEL-02-02 accepted dimensions or record a human-approved upstream unit vocabulary amendment before downstream use. Stage 2 technical evidence: schemas/section.schema.yaml now uses second_moment_area, section_modulus, volume_per_length, and mass_per_length from the accepted PKG-02 DimensionId vocabulary and excludes area_moment. tests/test_component_section_schema.py asserts SectionDimension is a subset of the PKG-02 unit dimension enum.

Description: The fixture named invented_section_component_library_valid.json is a combined section/component payload. It lacks required top-level keys for either strict schema (for example completeness_rules, diagnostics, open_decisions, and field_definitions for component) and contains prefixed keys that strict schemas would reject as additional properties. Existing tests inspect selected fields but do not validate the fixture as a JSON Schema instance.
ProposedDisposition: Split or wrap fixtures under a governed envelope, or add schema-validation tests proving the accepted payload shape before claiming round-trip or schema compatibility. Stage 2 technical evidence: added strict split fixtures fixtures/component/invented_section_library_valid.json and fixtures/component/invented_component_library_valid.json. The legacy combined fixture now points to those strict fixtures, and tests/test_component_section_schema.py validates both split fixtures against section.schema.yaml and component.schema.yaml.
